title: What happens to your body if you don't sleep for 24 hours? (Vex, Scribe)

beats.say: [seductive, low voice] What happens to your body if you don't sleep for twenty-four hours? [whispers] Come here, baby. Mommy will tell you.
Hour seventeen. Your brain is as slow as someone who's had a few drinks.
Hour twenty. Your hunger hormone climbs. [laughs softly] That's why you're on your third bag of chips.
Hour twenty-two. Microsleeps. Your brain naps for a few seconds... [whispers] with your eyes open.
Hour twenty-four. You're as impaired as someone legally drunk. And your brain is forty percent worse at saving new memories. [sighs] So that all-nighter for your bio homework? [softly] Gone.
[seductive whisper] So let mommy take care of you.
Snap the worksheet. Scribe answers every question, and writes it out in your handwriting. Even the graph. [breathy] Stroke... by... stroke.
Now put the phone down and go to sleep, baby. [whispers] Mommy's orders.
